n50b499d2c7.headline: The government is divided on the tax issue, Babiš's proposal torpedoes ČSSD and the opposition
n50b499d2c7.summary: Prime Minister Andrej Babiš proposes replacing the super-gross wage with a 15% income tax for most employees, opposed by ČSSD and other parties favoring higher rates or brackets.
n50b499d2c7.why: Tax policy changes affect labor markets, disposable income, and business costs, influencing economic growth and investor sentiment in the Czech Republic.
